Ensure the flow

The fuel pump moves fuel from the tank to the engine. It has two blades and one electric motor. The motor turns the blades at a constant speed.

  • The tank holds the fuel
  • The pump moves the fuel
  • The filter removes dirt from the fuel

Verify the pressure

Utilize the wrench to modify the setting.

Do these steps to adjust the pressure.

  1. Turn the adjustment screw on the left side of the pressure regulator clockwise until the gauge shows the correct value for the system.
  2. Close the drain valve and remove the filter cover with the wrench.

The pump starts when the engine starts ensure.
